title: How is the Queen connected to Freddy Fazbear?
description: Five real pictures connect Queen Elizabeth II to Freddy Fazbear from Five Nights at Freddy's.
hook: How is Queen Elizabeth the Second connected to Freddy Fazbear?

image.file: File:Barack Obama Michelle Obama Queen Elizabeth II Buckingham Palace London.jpg

links.line: In 2009, Queen Elizabeth the Second welcomed Barack Obama to Buckingham Palace.

image.file: File:President Barack Obama talks with Jimmy Kimmel during a Jimmy Kimmel Live! video taping in Los Angeles, California, March 12, 2015. (Official White House Photo by Pete Souza).jpg

links.line: In 2015, Obama was a guest on Jimmy Kimmel's late-night show.
In 2018, Kimmel shared a Los Angeles stage with fellow host Conan O'Brien.

image.file: File:SDCC 2015 - Conan O'Brien, Francis Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Jennifer Lawrence & Liam Hemsworth (19035435903).jpg

links.line: At Comic-Con 2015, Conan hosted a Hunger Games panel with Josh Hutcherson.
And in 2023, Hutcherson played the night guard hunted by Freddy Fazbear in the Five Nights at Freddy's movie.
